set.t: A descendant posting online denies the bounty-money story; no period paper yet mentions a cache. The island is built over with cottages: look only. He died a pauper, which argues against the cache. The 1900 census finds him living in Norwich Twp, Missaukee Co., by Moorestown, matching the Feb 1900 report that he had left the island for his son's; he was back on the island by his death in Aug 1902. No dig or find has ever been reported.
